task.subject: fix(platform): preserve V2 replay on opaque budget rejection

winning_diff:
--- a/tests/platform_protocol/g2_a0_model_gate_v2_cli.py
+++ b/tests/platform_protocol/g2_a0_model_gate_v2_cli.py
@@ -218,9 +218,14 @@
         try:
             completion_result = self._completion(canonical_request, api_key)
         except DeepSeekClientViolation as error:
-            status = "rejected"
-            reason_codes = (error.code,)
-            trace_key = "rejected_after_call"
+            if error.code == "budget_exceeded":
+                status = "inconclusive"
+                reason_codes = ("provider_call_ambiguous",)
+                trace_key = "inconclusive"
+            else:
+                status = "rejected"
+                reason_codes = (error.code,)
+                trace_key = "rejected_after_call"
         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
             status = "inconclusive"
             reason_codes = ("provider_call_ambiguous",)
